en: Click Contact Us to speak directly with Ellis Perth about your property job. We arrange the assessment, check the work and access, and confirm the scope and written quote.
Contact our Perth team about the repairs you need. We arrange an assessment, check the work and access, and set out the agreed scope in a written quote.
zh: 点击“联系我们”，直接向 Ellis 珀斯咨询物业维修。我们会安排评估、检查工作内容与进场条件，并确认维修范围及书面报价。
请联系珀斯团队，说明需要进行的维修。我们会安排现场评估、检查工作内容及进场条件，并在书面报价中列明商定范围。

en: Agree the visit purpose, attending team and access directly with Ellis. Existing photos and measurements are optional; tell us who can arrange entry and approve the quote.
We confirm the visit purpose, attending team and access arrangements with you. Existing photos and measurements are optional; let us know who can arrange entry and approve the quote.
zh: 直接与 Ellis 商定到访目的、上门团队及进场安排。现有照片和尺寸可自愿提供；请说明谁能安排进场及批准报价。
我们会与您确认到访目的、上门人员及进场安排。现有照片和尺寸可自愿提供；请告知进场联系人及报价审批人。

en: Tell us whether the screen is on a door or window and whether the mesh, frame or hardware is damaged. Confirm the required material and fit after assessment.
Tell us whether the screen is on a door or window and whether the mesh, frame or hardware is damaged. We check the unit on site and confirm the materials and fit for the repair.
zh: 请说明是纱门还是纱窗，以及纱网、框架或五金是否损坏。评估后再确认所需材料和适配情况。
请告诉我们纱网装在门上还是窗上，以及损坏的是网面、框架还是五金。我们会现场检查，确认维修所需的材料及适配方式。

en: For a coastal home or established property, weathered timber and stiff window fittings may be visible, but the repair still depends on the material and surrounding condition. Tell us whether the concern is a loose fitting, damaged finish, a gap or a part that no longer moves correctly. Mention earlier repairs if known. A broad coastal location alone does not establish why a particular component has failed.

We assess weathered timber, stiff window fittings, gaps and damaged finishes around Fremantle. Tell us which part needs attention and any earlier repairs you know about; we check the material and surrounding condition before recommending the work.
zh: 沿海或成熟社区房屋可能有明显的木材风化或窗户配件卡涩，但如何维修仍取决于材质及周边状况。告诉我们 问题是配件松动、涂饰损伤、出现缝隙，还是部件无法正常活动。如了解以往维修情况，请一并说明。仅凭沿海位置，无法判断某个部件的故障原因。
我们处理 Fremantle 一带风化木材、门窗五金卡滞、缝隙及饰面损坏等维修需求。请说明受影响的部位及已知维修记录；我们会先检查材料和周边状况，再说明处理方案。

en: A loose cabinet hinge should be described alongside the condition of the panel and fixing holes. A damaged wall patch may also need paint preparation, but colour matching depends on the existing finish. If an exterior timber surface is soft, split or flaking, explain what is visible from a safe position. We check the material condition and repair boundary before discussing replacement, preparation or painting. An enquiry does not establish that a particular treatment will suit the surface.

We check loose cabinet hinges, damaged fixing holes, wall patches and weathered exterior timber. We explain suitable repair, preparation or replacement options and discuss how the finish will look against the existing surface. Describe what you can see safely; we inspect the affected area on site.
zh: 橱柜铰链松动请同时描述面板及固定孔状况。墙面破损处可能还需上漆前处理，但配色取决于现有饰面。室外木面如发软、开裂或剥落，请说明从安全位置看到的情况。Ellis 会先检查材质状况及维修边界，再讨论更换、基层处理或油漆。提交咨询并不能确定某种处理适合该表面。
我们会检查松动的橱柜铰链、损坏的固定孔、墙面补块及风化的室外木材，说明适合的维修、基层处理或更换方案，并与您讨论新旧饰面的衔接效果。请描述从安全位置看到的情况，我们会现场检查受影响区域。

en: After you submit a request, our customer service team will call you to discuss the job and confirm the assessment appointment. Tell us who arranges entry and who can approve the repair quote; those may be different people.

After you send an enquiry, our team contacts you to discuss the work and confirm an assessment time and access arrangements. Let us know who can arrange entry and who approves the repair quote. Sending the form starts the enquiry; we confirm the appointment directly with you.
zh: 提交需求后，客服团队会致电讨论工作并确认评估预约。请说明谁安排进场、谁可批准维修报价；这可能是不同的人。
收到咨询后，我们会联系您讨论工作内容，并确认评估时间及进场安排。请告知进场联系人和维修报价审批人。提交表单是开始咨询，预约由我们直接与您确认。

en: We assess the property, materials, access and agreed tasks before providing a written quote. For several small jobs, list each repair and its location so we can identify what is included. Agree the assessment purpose and any stated visit charge before booking; approve the repair scope and price separately after assessment.

We assess the property, materials, access and repair list, then provide a written quote. For several small jobs, list each item and its location so we can plan the work together. Before the visit, we explain its purpose and any applicable attendance charge; you approve the repair scope and price after assessment.
zh: 我们会评估房屋、材料、进场条件及约定事项，再提供书面报价。多项小修请逐项列出维修及位置，以明确包含范围。预约前商定评估目的及已说明的到访费用；评估后另行批准维修范围及价格。
我们会评估物业、材料、进场条件及维修清单，再提供书面报价。多项小修请逐项说明位置，方便我们统筹安排。到访前，我们会说明评估目的及适用的上门费用；评估后，由您批准维修范围与价格。

en: Before approving work, ask us to confirm the pricing basis, materials, any assessment or attendance charges and separate trade work. If additional damage changes the job, ask for the revised work and price to be agreed before extra repairs proceed.

We set out the pricing basis, materials, any assessment or attendance charges and separate trade work before you approve the job. If additional damage changes the work, we explain the revised scope and price and obtain your approval before proceeding with extra repairs.
zh: 批准施工前，请确认计价方式、材料、评估或上门费用，以及另行安排的专业工种工作。如果新发现的损伤改变了工作内容，请先商定调整后的工作和价格，再继续额外维修。
我们会在您批准施工前说明计价方式、材料、评估或上门费用，以及单独安排的工种工作。如发现额外损坏，我们会说明调整后的范围和价格，并在获得您批准后进行额外维修。

en: Confirm the written scope, relevant experience, any required credentials, proposed timing and how questions or variations will be handled before work starts.
Before work starts, we explain the repair scope, relevant experience and credentials, proposed timing and how we handle questions or changes to the job.
zh: 开工前确认书面范围、相关经验、必要资质、拟定时间，以及问题或变更的处理方式。
开工前，我们会说明维修范围、相关经验与资质、拟定时间，以及咨询和施工变更的处理方式。

en: The terms can have different implications. Ask us Perth team to label the document clearly and explain which conditions could change the amount.
We clearly label your quote or estimate and explain its scope, pricing basis and any conditions that could change the amount before you approve the work.
zh: 两者可能具有不同含义。请 Ellis 珀斯团队清楚标明文件性质，并说明哪些条件可能改变金额。
我们会在文件中明确标注报价或估价，说明工作范围、计价方式及可能影响金额的条件，再由您决定是否批准施工。

en: Ask for the reason, revised scope, price and timing impact in writing before authorising a variation, unless an agreed safety action is required.
If the work changes, we explain the reason, revised scope, price and timing in writing before seeking your approval. Any immediate safety action is handled as agreed with you.
zh: 除非需要采取已约定的安全措施，否则批准变更前，请要求书面说明原因、修订范围、价格及对时间的影响。
如工作内容有变，我们会先书面说明原因、调整后的范围、价格及时间安排，再征得您的批准。需要立即采取的安全措施按双方约定处理。

en: Ask us for the credentials and insurance relevant to the agreed work. Our own appropriately licensed personnel complete regulated tasks. Check the applicable licence through the official regulator before work starts; the licensed-work guide links the WA search resource.

We explain the credentials and insurance information relevant to your agreed work. Our own appropriately licensed employees complete regulated tasks. You can request the applicable licence details before work starts.
zh: 向 Ellis 索取约定工作相关的资质及保险资料。受监管任务由我们具有相应执照的人员完成。开工前通过官方监管机构核查适用执照；这份 持牌工作指南 提供西澳查询资源链接。
我们会说明与商定工作相关的资质和保险信息。受监管工作由公司自有的相应持牌员工完成；开工前，您可向我们索取适用的执照资料。

en: Tell us the open-home or photography date as well as the repair list, then ask what can be assessed and completed in the available arrangements. Materials, drying, access and authorised work can affect the sequence. A preferred date is not a confirmed attendance or completion promise, and a cosmetic repair does not establish that the property is free of concealed defects.

Tell us your open-home or photography date and priority repair list. We assess the work, materials, drying times and access, then agree a practical sequence and completion target with you. We confirm the appointment and the repair scope directly.
zh: 告诉我们 开放看房或拍摄日期及维修清单，并询问现有安排下可评估和完成什么。材料、干燥、进场及授权工作会影响顺序。期望日期不代表确认上门或承诺完工；外观修复也不能证明房屋没有隐蔽缺陷。
请告诉我们开放看房或拍摄日期，以及优先维修清单。我们会评估工作内容、材料、干燥时间和进场条件，再与您商定施工顺序及目标完成时间，并直接确认预约和维修范围。

en: Conditions discovered on site can change a repair. Ask us Perth team to explain the new finding, proposed work, price and schedule effect before continuing. Record the agreed variation in writing and keep any updated photos with the job record. This protects clarity without assuming that every unexpected condition is avoidable.

If we find additional damage on site, we explain the finding, revised work, price and timing before asking you to approve the change. We record the agreed variation in writing so you can follow the repair scope and cost.
zh: 现场发现的状况可能改变维修。继续前请 Ellis 珀斯团队解释新发现、拟做工作、价格及工期影响。书面记录已同意的变更，并将更新照片与工作记录一同保存。这有助于保持明确，不代表所有意外情况都能避免。
如现场发现额外损坏，我们会先说明情况、调整后的工作、价格及时间安排，再请您批准变更。商定的变更会以书面记录，方便您了解维修范围与费用。

en: Pause, ask for the reason and document the revised work, cost and timing before authorising it.
We explain the reason for a change and record the revised work, cost and timing for your approval before continuing.
zh: 暂停工作，询问原因，并在批准前记录修订后的工作、费用及时间。
我们会说明变更原因，并记录调整后的工作、费用和时间安排，获得您批准后再继续。

en: The cost depends on the agreed task, materials, access and any separate trade work. We provide a written quote after assessment. Ask us to confirm whether the work is priced by time or by the job and whether attendance, assessment or minimum charges apply before approval.

We provide a written quote after assessing the task, materials, access and any separate trade work. The quote explains whether we charge by time or by the job, along with any applicable attendance, assessment or minimum charge, before you approve the work.
zh: 费用取决于约定任务、材料、进场条件及独立专业工种工作。我们评估后提供书面报价。批准前请确认按时还是按项目计价，以及是否有上门、评估或最低收费。
我们会评估任务、材料、进场条件及单独安排的工种工作，再提供书面报价。报价会写明按时间还是按项目计费，以及适用的上门、评估或最低收费，再由您决定是否批准。

en: Confirm the business identity and ask who will carry out each regulated task, with the applicable licence or registration details for that scope. A business name alone proves no trade qualification. We identify its own appropriate personnel during assessment.

We identify the employees responsible for each regulated task and explain the applicable licence or registration details before work begins. Our own appropriately licensed employees carry out the agreed regulated work.
zh: 确认企业身份，询问每项受监管任务由谁完成，并索取适用该范围的执照或注册资料。企业名称本身不能证明工种资格。Ellis 会在评估中明确适当自有人员。
我们会在开工前说明每项受监管工作的负责员工及适用的执照或注册资料。商定的受监管工作由公司自有的相应持牌员工完成。

en: Ask for the included tasks, materials and charging basis in writing. Shared access and preparation may reduce repeated setup, but grouping jobs does not establish a discount, minimum charge or a promise that everything fits one visit.

We list the included tasks, materials and charging basis in your written quote. For several jobs at one property, we plan shared access and preparation together and explain the proposed visit arrangements and costs.
zh: 要求以书面明确包含任务、材料及计价方式。共用进场和准备可能减少重复设置，但合并工作不代表已有折扣、最低收费或一次上门全部完成的承诺。
我们会在书面报价中列明包含的任务、材料和计价方式。同一物业有多项工作时，我们会统筹进场及准备安排，并说明拟定的到访安排与费用。

en: A nearby result, selected suburb or submitted request is a starting point for contact. Ask us to confirm the assessment purpose, attendance arrangements and any agreed assessment charge. Include a preferred day or deadline, but keep it separate from a confirmed appointment. Coverage alone cannot promise travel time or that every task can be finished on the first visit.

Tell us your suburb, the repair needed and your preferred day. We confirm the assessment purpose, available appointment time, access and any applicable attendance charge directly with you. We plan any further visits around the agreed work and required materials.
zh: 附近搜索结果、选中城区或提交需求都是联系起点。请 我们确认评估目的、上门安排及商定评估费。可提供期望日期或期限，但须与确认预约分开。覆盖范围不能保证行车时间或所有任务首访完成。
请告诉我们所在地区、维修事项及期望日期。我们会直接与您确认评估目的、可预约时间、进场安排及适用的上门费用，并根据商定工作及所需材料安排后续到访。

en: A damaged cabinet and a leaking sink are connected symptoms but do not form a single interchangeable trade task. The same distinction separates a TV bracket from a new power point. Check credentials against the specific work, agree the sequence and keep the regulated and general repair scopes clear. The FAQ questions explain common boundaries and link to official checks. The handyman service describes the small-repair scope; we confirm the appropriate arrangements for work that needs its own authorised personnel.

We assess a leaking sink and the resulting cabinet damage as connected jobs with separate plumbing and repair requirements. The same approach applies to a TV bracket and a new power point: we confirm the work sequence, responsible employees and written scope for each task.
zh: 柜体损坏与水槽漏水相互关联，但不是可互换的单一工种任务。电视支架与新增插座也有同样区别。按具体工作核查资质、商定顺序，并明确受监管与普通维修范围。常见问题解释常见边界并链接官方查询。家居维修服务说明小修范围；需要独立授权人员的工作，由 我们确认适当安排。
水槽漏水及由此造成的柜体损坏可以一并提出，但管道和柜体维修有各自的施工要求。电视支架和新增插座也按同样方式处理：我们会确认各项工作的顺序、负责员工及书面范围。

en: Replacement of damaged runners on the existing drawer shown. The supplied work record confirms runner replacement; it does not establish replacement of drawer boards or the surrounding wardrobe.
We replaced the damaged runners on the existing drawer shown in this case. The photographs document the runner replacement and the drawer after it was refitted.
zh: 更换所示现有抽屉的损坏滑轨。提供的工作记录确认滑轨更换，不能确定更换过抽屉板材或周边衣柜。
这个案例展示了我们为现有抽屉更换损坏滑轨的工作。照片记录了滑轨更换及抽屉复位后的状态。

en: The final photograph shows the finished exterior window and entry view. The visible finish does not establish concealed timber condition.
The final photograph shows the repaired exterior window and entrance finish.
zh: 最后照片展示完工窗户及入口外观，可见饰面不能确定隐蔽木材状况。
完工照片展示了修复后的室外窗户及入口饰面。

en: The final photograph shows two shelves installed and arranged with household items. It does not establish the wall construction, concealed fixings or a load rating for these shelves or another installation.
The final photograph shows the two installed shelves with household items arranged on them. For a similar installation, we check your wall, brackets and intended use before selecting fixings.
zh: 最后照片展示已安装两块搁板及摆放的家居物品。它不能确定墙体构造、隐蔽固定件，或这些搁板及其他安装的承重额定值。
完工照片展示了安装好的两块搁板及摆放其上的家居用品。如需类似安装，我们会先检查您的墙体、支架及使用需求，再选择固定方式。

en: The final photograph shows the remeshed screen-door presentation. This example concerns an ordinary flyscreen and does not establish security-screen performance.
The final photograph shows the ordinary flyscreen door after remeshing. For security-screen work, tell us the product type so we can assess its separate mesh, frame and hardware requirements.
zh: 最后照片展示换网后的纱门。本例是普通纱门，不能证明防盗纱门性能。
完工照片展示了普通纱门换网后的状态。如需防盗纱网相关工作，请说明产品类型，我们会评估其网材、框架及五金要求。

en: Ask us to confirm the applicable price basis and any fees or inclusions in your written quote.
We set out the pricing basis, fees and included work in your written quote so you can see the scope of the job.
zh: 请要求我们在书面报价中确认适用的计价方式、相关费用及包含项目。
我们会在书面报价中列明计价方式、相关费用及包含项目，方便您了解本次工作的范围。

en: We assess the existing slab and surface before recommending resurfacing. The work addresses a suitable surface, not a promise to correct every crack or movement problem. Describe peeling coatings, worn areas and any pooling water.

We assess the existing concrete slab, worn areas, peeling coatings and any pooling water before recommending resurfacing. We explain the preparation and finish, and identify cracks or movement that need separate repair before resurfacing.
zh: Ellis 会先评估现有混凝土板和表面，再建议是否翻新。该工程针对适合处理的表面，并不承诺解决所有裂缝或位移问题。请描述涂层剥落、磨损区域及积水情况。
我们会先评估现有混凝土板、磨损部位、剥落涂层及积水，再说明适合的翻新方案，包括基层处理、饰面，以及翻新前需要单独维修的裂缝或位移问题。

en: The plan records treatment areas, preparation, occupant or pet precautions and any included follow-up. Method and timing depend on the assessment; a general pest enquiry does not confirm every species, a particular chemical treatment or ongoing elimination. We confirm the appropriate personnel for the work, including our own appropriately licensed personnel for regulated tasks.

We record the treatment areas, preparation, occupant and pet precautions, and any included follow-up in the agreed plan. After assessing the pest and property, we explain the treatment method, timing and personnel, including our own appropriately licensed employees for regulated work.
zh: 方案会记录处理区域、准备工作、住户或宠物防护措施，以及包含的后续服务。方法与时间取决于评估；一般虫害咨询并不代表涵盖所有物种、某种特定药剂处理或持续根除。我们会确认适合承担工作的人选；受监管任务由其自有、具备相应牌照的人员负责。
我们会在商定方案中写明处理区域、准备工作、住户及宠物注意事项，以及包含的后续安排。评估虫害及物业后，我们会说明处理方法、时间与施工人员；受监管工作由公司自有的相应持牌员工完成。

en: A worn sweep or seal needs a compatible profile and a check of where water escapes. Replacing a seal may suit a serviceable screen when that edge is the cause; it is not a promise to fix every shower leak. Persistent moisture can require separate wet-area or plumbing investigation.

We check the worn seal or sweep, its profile and where water is escaping before recommending replacement. If moisture comes from another part of the shower, we explain the wet-area or plumbing investigation needed rather than replacing a seal that will not address the cause.
zh: 磨损的挡水条或密封条，需要确认适配规格及水从哪里流出。如果淋浴屏仍可使用，且漏水确由该边缘引起，更换密封条可能合适；这并不保证解决所有淋浴间漏水。持续潮湿可能需要单独排查湿区或管道问题。
我们会先检查磨损的密封条、挡水条、截面及漏水位置，再建议是否更换。如水分来自淋浴区其他部位，我们会说明所需的湿区或管道排查，不会只更换无法解决原因的密封条。

en: Tell us whether you want window supply included or already have a product. We check the supplied specification and opening before agreeing installation; purchasing a window does not establish that it will fit.
Tell us whether you need window supply included or already have a window. We check the product specification and opening dimensions before confirming the installation arrangements.
zh: 请说明是否需要我们供应窗户，或您已经购买产品。确认安装前，我们会核对产品规格与洞口；已经买好的窗户也需要检查是否适合。
请告诉我们是否需要将窗户供货列入方案，或您已有窗产品。我们会检查产品规格和洞口尺寸，再确认安装安排。

en: Agree who removes and disposes of the old unit, the required flashings and seals, and any internal or external finishing. The written quote identifies which materials and tasks are included, rather than treating fitting alone as a complete replacement package.

During the assessment, we identify the removal, disposal, flashing, sealing and finishing work and set out the arrangements in your quote. Installation-only work and a complete window replacement are scoped separately so you can compare the work and cost.
zh: 先确认由谁拆除及清运旧窗、所需泛水与密封处理，以及室内外的收口修复。书面报价会列明包含的材料与工作，不会将单纯安装视为整套更换工程。
我们会在勘察时梳理旧窗拆除、清运、泛水、密封和周边收口的工作，并在报价中写明每项安排。仅安装与整窗更换分别列明范围，方便您比较方案和费用。

en: Hourly installation labour and window supply per square metre are different price bases, not a complete installed-window total. Confirm measurement, supply, removal, disposal, sealing and finishing in the written quote.

Once we agree the installation scope, we provide a written quote setting out the materials, labour and work. We explain the arrangements for window supply, old-window removal and disposal, sealing, and internal and external finishing, including what is included and what is priced separately.
zh: 按小时计算的安装人工，与按平方米计算的窗户供应费用，是不同的计价依据，并非整窗安装总价。请在书面报价中确认测量、供应、拆旧、清运、密封及收口修复的包含范围。
我们会在确认安装范围后提供书面报价，列明本次材料、人工和施工项目。窗户供货、旧窗拆除与清运、密封及室内外收口的安排，我们会逐项说明，列清包含项目与另行计费的工作。

en: Tell us which areas are uncomfortable and what you know about the existing insulation. We assess accessible coverage and condition before recommending filling gaps or a broader upgrade. A comfort complaint alone does not establish the required material.

Tell us which rooms are uncomfortable and what you know about the existing insulation. We inspect accessible coverage and condition, explain the suitable materials and identify whether filling gaps or a broader upgrade is needed.
zh: 告诉我们 哪些区域不舒适，以及您了解的现有保温隔热情况。我们会先评估可接近区域的覆盖及状况，再建议补缺或较大范围升级。仅凭舒适度问题不能确定所需材料。
请告诉我们哪些房间冷热不适，以及您了解的现有保温情况。我们会检查可进入区域的覆盖及材料状况，说明适合的材料，并判断需要补充空缺还是进行更大范围的改善。

en: We check the visible condition, retained ground and nearby structures before agreeing repair or replacement. The ground pressure and water conditions matter. Simply matching the old wall does not establish that the same design remains suitable.

We inspect the retaining wall, retained ground, drainage and nearby structures before recommending repair or replacement. We explain the design and approval requirements for the proposed work and set out the agreed scope in your quote.
zh: 我们会检查可见状况、被挡土体及附近结构，再商定维修或更换。土压力及水分状况很重要。仅匹配旧墙，不能证明相同设计仍适用。
我们会先检查挡土墙、挡土状况、排水和周边结构，再说明维修或更换方案，并解释拟进行工作的设计及审批要求，在报价中列明商定范围。

en: Available plans, engineering information and site details help define the work. The agreed deliverable should identify the relevant project and exclusions. A certification enquiry is not a promise that an unassessed proposal will receive approval.

Share any available plans, engineering information and site details. We confirm the certification work, required documents and relevant authority responsibilities before engagement, so you know which part of the approval process we are handling.
zh: 现有图纸、工程设计资料及场地详情有助于明确工程。商定交付文件应注明相关项目和除外内容。认证咨询不代表承诺未经评估的方案会获批准。
如有现成图纸、工程资料和现场信息，请一并提供。我们会在委托前说明认证工作、所需文件及相关主管部门的职责，让您清楚了解我们负责的审批环节。

en: Design may require calculations, drawings and details for the defined change. Construction is a separate work scope using the agreed design and applicable approvals; an assessment booking does not automatically include either design or construction. We confirm the appropriate team and deliverables for your project.

We explain whether your project needs engineering advice, calculations, drawings or construction work. Each stage has its own scope and applicable approvals; we confirm the responsible team, deliverables and quote before you engage that stage.
zh: 设计可能需要针对明确改动的计算、图纸和细节。施工是依据商定设计及适用批准的独立工程范围；预约评估不自动包括设计或施工。我们会为您的项目确认合适的团队及交付内容。
我们会说明项目需要工程意见、计算、图纸还是施工作业。各阶段分别明确范围及适用审批，并在您委托该阶段前确认负责团队、交付文件及报价。

en: Only work explicitly agreed in the quote is included. Building work, drafting and certification documentation are distinct tasks. Confirm the project objective, access and documents you need so each stage can be scoped clearly.

We set out the engineering work and deliverables in your quote. Tell us your project objective and any documents you need so we can identify drafting, building work or certification that requires a separate scope.
zh: 仅包含报价中明确商定的工程。 建筑施工, 制图 以及 认证文件 是不同任务。请确认项目目标、进场及所需文件，以便清楚划定各阶段范围。
我们会在报价中列明工程工作及交付文件。请说明项目目标和所需文件，方便我们识别需要单独列明范围的绘图、施工或认证工作。

en: We check the condition, materials and specialist requirements, then set out the accepted tasks and exclusions in writing. Confirm the scope and price basis before work proceeds.
We check the condition, materials and specialist requirements, then give you the work scope, inclusions, exclusions and pricing basis in writing before you approve the repairs.
zh: 我们检查现场状况、材料及专业施工需求，再以书面列明承接任务及排除项目。施工前确认范围及计价方式。
我们会检查物业状况、材料和专业工种要求，并在您批准维修前，以书面列明工作范围、包含项、不包含项及计价方式。

en: Work follows the approved list. Extra damage or changed materials are discussed for approval before additional work. Agree the completion summary or photos you need for handover.

We work from the approved repair list and discuss extra damage or changed materials with you before additional work. Before the visit, we agree the completion summary or photographs needed for handover.
zh: 按获批清单施工。如发现额外损坏或需要更换材料，先讨论并获得批准，再开展新增工作。商定交接所需的完工摘要或照片。
我们会按已批准的维修清单施工。发现额外损坏或材料变化时，会先与您讨论，再进行额外工作；到访前，也会商定交接所需的完工摘要或照片。

en: Keep the approved list and agreed summary or before-and-after photos. Record the item, room and any unfinished or separately approved tasks. Photos should avoid occupants, keys and private documents; they do not prove concealed work. For approved strata or common-property repairs, agree completion photos and summaries with the responsible contact as part of the accepted scope; they are not an automatic reporting package.

We agree the handover records with the authorised contact before work begins, including any completion summary or photographs. These records identify the repaired items, rooms and any separately approved tasks. We keep occupants, keys and private documents out of agreed repair photographs.
zh: 保留获批清单及商定的摘要或维修前后照片。记录部件、房间及尚未完成或另行审批的任务。照片应避开住户、钥匙和私人文件；照片不能证明隐蔽工程状况。对于获批的分层物业或共用区域维修，应与负责联系人商定是否将完工照片和摘要纳入承接范围；这些资料并非自动包含的报告服务。
我们会在开工前与授权联系人商定交接记录，包括所需的完工摘要或照片。记录会说明维修项目、房间及单独批准的工作；拍摄约定的维修照片时，会避开住户、钥匙和私人文件。

en: Tell us Perth which exterior wall needs attention and your suburb. Safe wide and close-up photos are optional; email them to handyman.maintenance.au@outlook.com if available. We arrange the site assessment and confirm the cladding repair scope and quote.
Tell us which exterior wall needs attention and your suburb. Safe existing photographs are optional. We inspect the wall and confirm the cladding repair scope and written quote.
zh: 请告知 Ellis 珀斯团队哪面外墙需处理及所在城区。安全拍摄全景和近照可自愿提供；如有，可发送至 handyman.maintenance.au@outlook.com。我们会安排现场评估，确认覆板维修范围及报价。
请告诉我们哪一面外墙需要处理，以及所在地区。安全拍摄的现有照片可自愿提供；我们会现场检查，并确认外墙板维修范围及书面报价。

en: This project documents visible wall repair followed by paint preparation and finishing. It provides a practical reference for minor patching and repainting enquiries rather than a promise of a matching finish.
This case shows wall repair, paint preparation and the finished surface. For your room, we inspect the existing coating and discuss the repair area and finish before quoting.
zh: 本项目记录可见墙面维修及后续油漆准备和饰面，为小型修补及重刷咨询提供实用参考，并非匹配饰面的承诺。
这个案例展示了墙面维修、油漆基层处理及完成后的表面效果。针对您的房间，我们会先检查现有涂层，并与您讨论维修面积及饰面，再提供报价。

en: Gardeners focus on plant and garden-care tasks; handyman work concerns suitable fittings and minor repairs. A clean-up can involve both, but each task needs its own scope and equipment. Ellis assigns the appropriate own-team work rather than assuming all outdoor tasks are interchangeable.

We plan garden care and minor outdoor repairs as separate tasks within the same request. We identify the employees, equipment and materials needed for each, then explain the work sequence and waste arrangements in your quote.
zh: 园艺人员专注植物及花园养护；家居维修处理适合的配件及小修。清理可涉及两者，但各任务须分别确定范围及设备。我们会安排适合的自有团队工作，不会认为所有户外任务可以互换。
园艺养护和室外小修可以一并提出，我们会分别列明各项工作所需的员工、设备和材料，并在报价中说明施工顺序及废物处理安排。

en: Plant care and garden tidying differ from fixing fittings or repairing edging. Describe both in one request if helpful; we check the scope, personnel and waste arrangements for each rather than assuming one service includes everything.
Tell us the garden care, clean-up and minor repair work you need. We identify the tasks, employees and waste arrangements for each and explain what is included in the agreed service.
zh: 植物护理及花园整理不同于配件固定或花坛边缘维修。如方便，可在同一咨询中描述两类任务；Ellis 会逐项核查范围、人员及废物安排，不会假定一种服务包含所有工作。
请告诉我们需要进行的园艺养护、清理及小型维修。我们会逐项明确工作、负责员工和废物处理安排，并说明商定服务包含哪些内容。

en: Describe the garden work and any repair list together. We confirm suitable own-team scopes, materials and waste arrangements before booking; a garden enquiry does not establish acceptance of every outdoor trade task.
Describe the garden work and repair list together. We confirm the work for our team, materials and waste arrangements before booking, so you can see how each task will be handled.
zh: 请一并描述园艺工作及维修清单。预约前，我们会确认适合的自有团队范围、材料及废物安排；园艺咨询并不代表承接所有户外工种任务。
园艺工作和维修清单可以一并说明。预约前，我们会确认团队负责的工作、材料及废物处理安排，让您了解每项任务如何进行。

en: Confirm accessible edges, clippings collection or mulching, green-bin use and any extra green-waste removal. Mowing does not include every garden task: use garden clean-up for broader overgrowth and garden maintenance for other agreed care.

We agree mowing edges, clipping collection or mulching, green-bin use and any additional green-waste removal with you before the visit. Broader overgrowth and other garden care are listed separately in the quote.
zh: 请确认可接近边缘、草屑收集或碎化还田、绿废垃圾桶使用及额外绿化废物清运。割草不包含所有园艺任务：较大范围杂生植被请选择 花园清理 ，而 花园养护 适用于其他商定养护。
到访前，我们会与您确认割草边界、收集草屑或覆盖处理、绿废桶使用及额外绿废清运安排。较大范围的杂草清理和其他园艺养护会在报价中单独列明。

en: Confirm your preference when the mowing visit is scoped. Collection or mulching depends on the agreed service and the lawn's condition; do not assume clipping removal is automatically included.
Tell us whether you prefer clipping collection or mulching. We check the lawn condition and explain the agreed method and any removal charge before the visit.
zh: 确定割草上门范围时请确认偏好。收集或碎化还田取决于商定服务及草坪状况；请勿默认自动包含草屑清运。
请告诉我们希望收集草屑还是就地覆盖处理。我们会检查草坪状况，并在到访前说明商定的处理方式及适用的清运费用。

en: Our Southern Corridor drawer runner replacement includes only before and after photographs. The confirmed work is replacement of damaged runners. It does not establish hidden fixing details, new drawer boards or replacement of the wardrobe.

Our Southern Corridor drawer case shows the drawer before and after damaged runners were replaced. For a similar repair, we check your runners, drawer and cabinet before recommending the parts and work.
zh: 我们的 Southern Corridor 抽屉滑轨更换案例 仅包含施工前后照片。已确认工程为更换损坏的滑轨，并不能据此确认隐蔽固定细节、新抽屉板材或衣柜更换。
Southern Corridor 抽屉案例展示了更换损坏滑轨前后的状态。如需类似维修，我们会先检查您的滑轨、抽屉和柜体，再说明所需配件及工作。

en: New panels, replacement cabinetry, finish matching and disposal are separate scope decisions. Tell us what you want assessed and who can approve the work. The written quote states the agreed repair, supplied parts, removal and disposal rather than assuming these are included.

We explain any new panels, replacement cabinetry, finish matching and disposal needed for the repair. Your written quote lists the agreed repair work, supplied parts, removal and disposal, with separate charges clearly identified.
zh: 新面板、更换柜体、饰面匹配和废料清运都需分别确认范围。请告知 Ellis 您希望评估的项目及谁有权批准工程。书面报价会列明商定维修、供应配件、拆除和清运，不能默认包括这些内容。
我们会说明维修需要的新板材、柜体更换、饰面衔接及清运工作。书面报价会列明商定维修、供应配件、拆除和清运安排，并明确单独计费的项目。

en: Old-profile availability and sound fixing material determine whether a local match is practical. Confirm painting or staining separately from fitting the timber; new trim does not automatically arrive with the same finish as the existing room.
We check the existing trim profile, available matching timber and the fixing surface. We explain whether painting or staining is needed and list it separately from fitting the timber in your quote.
zh: 旧款造型是否仍可取得，以及固定基层是否完好，决定局部匹配是否可行。刷漆或染色需与木材安装分别确认；新线条并不自动具备与房间原有饰面相同的效果。
我们会检查现有装饰线条、可匹配木材及固定表面，并说明是否需要油漆或染色处理，在报价中与木材安装分别列明。

en: Replacement skirting may need filling, preparation and painting or staining to suit the agreed finish. Profile matching and colour matching are separate questions. The quote identifies the finish work rather than assuming installation includes repainting the whole room.
We check the skirting profile and discuss the finish you want. Your quote sets out fitting, filling, preparation and any agreed painting or staining, so you can see which finishing work is included.
zh: 更换踢脚线后，可能需要填补、基层处理、刷漆或染色，以达到商定饰面。造型匹配与颜色匹配需分别考虑。报价会明确饰面工程，不能假定安装包括整间房重新刷漆。
我们会检查踢脚线样式，并与您讨论期望的饰面。报价会列明安装、填补、基层处理及商定的油漆或染色工作，让您清楚了解包含哪些收面项目。

en: Our Canning clothesline bracket repair shows the existing unit before, during and after work. The confirmed scope is repair and restoration of a damaged bracket. Photographs do not establish hidden fixing details, wall construction or a tested load capacity.

Our Canning clothesline case shows the existing unit before, during and after its damaged bracket was repaired. For your clothesline, we check the bracket, fixings and wall or post before agreeing the repair method.
zh: 我们的 Canning 晾衣架支架维修案例 展示现有装置施工前、施工中及施工后的情况。已确认范围为维修和恢复受损支架。照片不能确认隐蔽固定细节、墙体构造或经过测试的承载能力。
Canning 晾衣架案例展示了受损支架维修前、施工中及修复后的状态。针对您的晾衣架，我们会先检查支架、固定件及墙体或立柱，再确认维修方法。

en: Confirm whether the packs are already in the room where the furniture will stand, and tell us about stairs, lifts and parking. Agree any unpacking, movement of packs or existing furniture before the visit. Leave enough room to lay out the parts and assemble the item without blocking access.

Tell us where the furniture packs are, where the finished furniture will stand, and about stairs, lifts and parking. We agree any pack movement, unpacking or existing-furniture movement with you before the visit and plan the working space needed for assembly.
zh: 请确认包装是否已放在家具最终摆放房间，并说明楼梯、电梯及停车情况。上门前商定开箱、包装搬移或现有家具搬移。请留足摆放配件和组装空间，勿阻塞通道。
请说明家具包装所在位置、安装后的摆放位置，以及楼梯、电梯和停车情况。到访前，我们会与您商定搬动包装、拆包或移动现有家具的工作，并规划组装所需的操作空间。

en: Assembly may need to pause while the correct replacement is obtained. Tell us about known missing parts or damage before the visit. We explain what remains incomplete rather than assuming an unsuitable substitute will work.
If a part is missing or damaged, we explain what can be assembled and what must wait for a suitable replacement. Tell us about any known missing items before the visit so we can plan the work.
zh: 可能需暂停组装，等待取得正确替换件。上门前，请告知已知缺件或损坏。我们会说明未完成事项，不会假定不适用的替代件能够使用。
如有配件缺失或损坏，我们会说明哪些部分可以组装、哪些需要等待合适的替换件。请在到访前告知已知缺件情况，方便我们安排工作。

en: Combining suitable tasks may avoid repeated travel or preparation, but different tools, missing parts and return stages can change the work. Compare the full written scope rather than assume a bundle will always cost less.

For several repairs at one property, we plan shared access and preparation together. We list the tools, parts and any return stages needed in the agreed scope and explain the overall price before you approve the work.
zh: 合并适用任务可能减少重复路程或准备，但不同工具、缺件及分阶段返工可能改变工程。请比较完整书面范围，不能假定打包总会更便宜。
同一物业有多项维修时，我们会统筹进场和准备工作，在商定范围中列明所需工具、配件及后续到访阶段，并在您批准前说明整体价格。

en: A useful quote identifies the tasks, labour basis, materials, supply responsibility, access assumptions, removal, disposal and exclusions. It should explain how changes are approved. Published service ranges do not establish the total for a specific property before assessment.

We set out the tasks, labour basis, materials, supply arrangements, access, removal, disposal and exclusions in your written quote. We also explain how changes are approved. Published service ranges remain a guide; your property quote follows the assessment.
zh: 清晰的报价应列明任务、人工计费方式、材料、供应责任、报价所依据的进场条件、拆除、清运及除外项目，并说明变更如何批准。已公布服务价格区间不能在评估前确定具体物业总价。
我们会在书面报价中列明任务、人工计价、材料、供货安排、进场、拆除、清运及不包含项，并说明变更如何审批。已公布的价格区间是参考，您的物业报价会在评估后确认。

en: We assess the proposed positions and explain any support or wall-condition issue before proceeding. Do not assume a general load figure applies to your wall. The Cockburn shelf installation example shows two shelves installed above a cabinet; photographs do not establish a load rating or concealed fixings.

We assess your preferred shelf positions, wall condition and support, then explain suitable fixings and any additional work before installation. Our Cockburn case shows two shelves installed above a cabinet; we check each property's own wall and intended shelf load.
zh: 我们会评估拟安装位置，并在施工前解释支撑或墙面状况问题。不能假定通用荷载数值适用于您的墙面。 Cockburn 搁板安装案例 展示橱柜上方安装的两块搁板；照片不能确认承载额定值或隐蔽固定件。
我们会评估您希望的搁板位置、墙体状况及支撑，安装前说明适合的固定方式和额外工作。Cockburn 案例展示了柜子上方两块搁板的安装；每处物业的墙体和搁板承重需求都会单独检查。

en: Keep the product instructions and mounting hardware available if you have them. We check the supplied bracket before fitting and identify any extra materials in the quote. Owning a bracket does not establish that it is suitable for the TV or wall.
Keep the TV instructions and mounting hardware available if you have them. We check that the bracket suits your TV and wall and identify any additional materials in the quote before fitting.
zh: 如有产品说明及安装五金，请备好。我们会在安装前检查自备支架，并在报价中注明额外材料。已有支架不代表它适合电视或墙体。
如有电视说明书和安装配件，请保留备用。我们会检查支架是否适合您的电视和墙体，并在安装前于报价中列明额外材料。

en: Where investigation identifies wider failure, the repair may require tile removal, substrate preparation, waterproofing and retiling. We coordinate the appropriate own-team scopes and identify exposure, plumbing, membrane work and reinstatement in the quote; no no-tile-removal cure is assumed.

If investigation identifies wider failure, we explain the tile removal, substrate preparation, waterproofing and retiling needed. Our team coordinates the agreed plumbing, membrane and reinstatement work and lists each part in the written quote.
zh: 调查发现更广泛失效时，维修可能需要拆砖、基层处理、防水及重新铺砖。Ellis 会协调自有团队各项合适范围，并在报价中注明暴露、管道、防水层及恢复工程；不能默认可免拆砖治漏。
如排查发现较大范围的失效，我们会说明所需的瓷砖拆除、基层处理、防水及重新铺贴工作。团队会统筹商定的管道、防水层和恢复施工，并在书面报价中逐项列明。

en: We check the affected boards and accessible support before agreeing a replacement. The condition beneath the surface matters. We identify board repair, fixing work and any structural investigation separately rather than assume a new coating will resolve instability.

We inspect the affected deck boards and accessible supports before recommending repairs. We explain which boards and fixings need work and identify any structural investigation separately from surface maintenance.
zh: 我们会检查受影响板材及可检查支撑，再商定更换。表面下状况很重要。板材维修、固定工程及结构调查分别列明，不能假定新涂层可解决不稳问题。
我们会先检查受影响的露台板和可检查的支撑，再说明维修方案，并区分木板、固定件维修、结构排查及表面保养的工作。

en: No. A condition inspection and building certification have different purposes and deliverables. If your request concerns proposed structural changes, see structural engineering assessment. Confirm which document is needed before booking rather than treating every property report as an approval.

A condition inspection and building certification provide different documents. We help define the inspection or report you need before booking. Proposed structural changes require an engineering assessment and their own agreed scope.
zh: 不是。状况检查与 建筑认证 的目的和交付内容不同。如请求涉及拟进行结构改动，请参阅 结构工程评估。预约前请确认所需文件，不能将所有物业报告视为批准。
房屋状况检查和建筑认证提供的文件不同。预约前，我们会与您明确所需检查或报告；拟进行的结构改动需要工程评估，并单独商定范围。
